title: Billing security review, data handling and documentation before any live mode
description:
Before billing/deployment.json ever says mode live, the billing surface gets the same review the identity surface had.

Feature: Billing security and data handling
  Scenario: Least privilege
    Then the billing runtime role reads and writes only prospectus-central/billing/* and reads only the two Stripe parameters; it cannot read identities, accounts or intake prefixes, and the account runtime cannot write billing
  Scenario: No secrets or contact data in logs
    Then captured logs during billing tests contain no key material, signing secret, card or bank fragment, email, name or address
  Scenario: Webhook abuse
    Then the webhook route rejects bodies over the limit, unsigned and stale events, and unknown event types with 400 and writes nothing; the throttle is documented
  Scenario: Retention
    Then billing contact data and invoices are kept for the period Ryan sets for financial records (open question), and SECURITY.md records it with the deletion request procedure
  Scenario: Documentation
    Then ARCHITECTURE.md (components, storage, routes), SECURITY.md (billing section, change control for Stripe keys and grants) and OPERATIONS.md (parameters, enabling test and live mode, rollback by disabling the flag, reconciliation) are current

Done looks like: an infra test asserting the role policies above (like the accounts-plane regression tests), the log-scan tests, and the documentation. Live mode is a separate reviewed change after this story closes and Ryan says go.

Data touched: none new.

Specs: `features/billing-stripe.feature` (security scenarios); `infra/test/billing-plane.test.ts`.
